title: SG-MMP: Reproducibility Package for Reasoning Fragility in Quantized Small Language Models
description: Code, fixed evaluation indices, redacted derived outcomes, paired statistical analyses, and figure-generation scripts for sensitivity-guided module-level mixed-precision repair of quantization-induced reasoning degradation in small language models. Version 1.2.0 adds standalone generation of the study-overview, precision-policy, and error-propagation figures from released JSON and CSV sources. Model weights, quantized states, raw benchmark records, and reasoning traces are not redistributed.
